items.name: grid-background
items.title: GridBackground
items.description: Decorative faint 0.3rem grid drawn with CSS gradients from the grid token. aria-hidden, pointer-events none.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Place <GridBackground /> as the first child of a relative container; it is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
